brief.text: The international break is already biting: an Arsenal winger and an 18-year-old international have both pulled out of their squads injured, and Arteta is sweating on the rest of his international stars. The transfer talk is loud but it's all rumour. Leipzig want up to £75m for an Arsenal target, Atletico are chasing Zubimendi with Arsenal reportedly weighing up a swap, and a 20-year-old striker is being watched ahead of January. The more sobering whisper is that Arsenal may still have to sell before they buy this winter despite £90m in sales, so don't expect a big January splash just yet. None of it is anywhere near a "here we go," so enjoy the gossip and keep the champagne on ice.
